name: Pixel Transition
description: Card that swaps between two pieces of content through a canvas pixel grid that covers the first content and then reveals the second, triggered by hover, focus, click or an external active flag.
contents: Focusable 300px wide rounded card with two stacked content layers (first and second)
Canvas overlay that draws the pixel grid transition
behavior: Pixels cover the first content during the first half and uncover the second content during the second half
Hover trigger plays on pointer enter and reverses on leave; keyboard focus-visible also triggers it
Click trigger toggles on click, Enter or Space; touch devices always toggle on tap
Can be controlled through active and onActiveChange
Transition origin follows the pointer entry point for ripple and wipe patterns
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by skipping the animation steps
editableByProps: Grid density (2 to 80), pixel color, mosaic tone variation, gap between pixels
Pixel animation (pop, grow, fade) and pixel shape (square, rounded, circle)
Speed, randomness of the wipe and ripple, frame rate cap
Hover or click trigger, controlled mode, one-way mode
Aspect ratio, extra classes and inline style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card width or corner radius

needsCodeEdit.where: PATTERNS constant and the delay calculation inside draw

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how wide the per-pixel animation window is

fixed: Card is a fixed 300px wide (max 100% of parent) with 16px rounded corners and overflow hidden
Root is focusable (tabIndex 0) and takes role button in click mode
Needs two content layers; both fill the card absolutely
Canvas resolution is capped at device pixel ratio 2
Hover and focus triggers ignore touch pointers; touch toggles on tap
Pixel overlay color is auto-darkened or lightened for mosaic tones
Unknown pattern, pixelAnimation or pixelShape values fall back to random, pop and square
Does not scale well to very small cards because the pixel grid is fixed by column count

options.look: Pixels appear in random order across the card
options.useWhen: Product or team card that flips to a reveal image on hover

options.look: Ordered Bayer dither fill with a retro halftone feel
options.useWhen: Retro or game themed portfolio tiles

options.look: Pixels spread outward from the pointer entry point
options.useWhen: Interactive gallery card where the reveal should follow the cursor

options.look: Pixels sweep in from the edge nearest the pointer
options.useWhen: Before and after or feature cards that slide to alternate content
